translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga Asafi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi kayimbidila mu ngitala.

content.text: Mu Yuda, Nzambi zabikini
Dizina diandi didi dinneni mu Iseli.
Nzo andi yi ngoto yidi ku Salemi,
buangu kiandi kidi ku Sioni.
Kuna kakeludila madionga malembo lemi,
nkaku ayi sabala, mbedi ayi binuanunu bi mvita.
Ngeyo lembo lezama mu kiezila,
lutidi kinzuku viokila miongo miwedi bibulu.
Makhesa mamana ku baziona bima,
balembo leki tulu tuawu tutsuka,
kadi wumosi mu binuani lenda tombula mioko miandi.
Mu themunuꞌaku, a Nzambi yi Yakobi,
ziphunda ayi matoma ma mvita
bibibiodi biledi tulu tuvindu.
Bileka tulu tuvindu.
Ngeyo veka, lembo monisa tsisi !
Nani wulenda telama va meso maku ngeyo fuema e ?
Tona kuna Diyilu wuwakikisa nzengolo ;
ntoto wumona tsisi ayi wutumbu dingalala ;
Thangu ngeyo, a Nzambi, wutelama mu diambu di sambisa
ayi mu diambu di vukisa bankwa ziphasi va ntoto.
Bukiedika nganzi aku kuidi batu yinnatini nzitusu ;
ayi bobo bavukidi mu nganzi aku, badi basimbudulu.
Tambikanu zikhanu kuidi Yave Nzambi eno
ayi dedikisanu ziawu !
Bika baboso badi mu nzunga ki mintoto,
banata bakaba kuidi mutu wowo widi tsisi.
Niandi weti bula phevi minyadi,
niandi tsisi beta kummona kuidi mintinu mi ntoto.

footnotes.text: 76.6 matoma ma mvita: voti matoma ma mvita ma bisengo.
